fullHistory.content: Generate a welcome quick-reference card for this Roba Studio project. Use exactly 4 markdown sections with these emoji headers: 🤖 Poses, ✋ Hands, 🎬 Animations, ⌨️ Code & Controls. Under each section list exactly 3 example prompts in double quotes. Rules: keep each example short (5 words max), write them as natural human requests not code instructions (e.g. "Make it wave" not "Set shoulder_vertical to -1.0"), use action verbs, make them feel fun and approachable. No intro sentence, no closing sentence, no descriptions. Just the 4 sections.

## 🤖 Poses
- "Show me a T‑pose"
- "Make the robot look up"
- "Tilt the head left"

## ✋ Hands
- "Open the left hand"
- "Close the right fingers"
- "Snap both hands together"

## 🎬 Animations
- "Wave the left arm"
- "Nod the robot"
- "Shake the head side‑to‑side"

## ⌨️ Code & Controls
- "Raise both arms simultaneously"
- "Make the robot dance"
- "Toggle pause and resume"
